# Field Guide to the Reading Room

The reading room opens at nine. Visitors sign the ledger before taking a seat.

## Handling manuscripts

Wash your hands before touching any manuscript. Cotton gloves are not required for
paper, because they reduce dexterity and cause more tears than they prevent.

1. Support the spine with foam wedges.
2. Turn pages from the upper corner.

- Pencils only, never ink.
- Laptops are allowed at the long tables.

### Fragile bindings

Bindings marked with a red slip must stay on the cradle at all times.

## Opening hours

| Day | Hours |
| --- | --- |
| Weekdays | 9:00 to 17:00 |
| Saturday | 10:00 to 14:00 |

> Closed on public holidays, without exception.

```python
def is_open(hour: int) -> bool:
    return 9 <= hour < 17
```
